scope: Existing regression tests execute unmodified runtime baselines and three copy-only representative mutants on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7. Every final mutant fails its intended assertion, with no fixture/container/block error. Final source digests agree across hosts.
cleanupContract: Atomically allocate an unpredictable new child beneath held ordinary repository/.wac-local ancestry; no caller-supplied deletion root. Hold root identity and deny shared DELETE. Enumerate and pin every descendant before the first deletion, reject reparse points, check identity and delete by held handle bottom-up. On refusal retain the tree and release pins without a recursive path-delete fallback.
limits: Three representative defects only, not exhaustive mutation coverage.
Wrong sample rate checks the ordinary encoder argv contract, not an actual FFmpeg render or media result.
Bad-exit uses the real installed-compiler synthetic native fixture returning 7, not a mocked process result.
No user audio, saved settings, application output, listening, broad stress, crash, power-loss or other Windows-release result is claimed.
